title: Mutacraft
description: A medium sized kitchen-sink pack made for a private SMP server
body:
# Description:
A kitchen-sink modpack created for a private SMP server. This pack has mainly client-side quality of life/performance mods. It also has a couple of content mods for exploration, decoration, more interesting progression, overhauling the food system, and a couple of other things.

Made by Muta and Gato

# Attribution:
This pack was built using Fabulously Optimized as a base, and contains all of the mods within that project. Notably, it uses [mod menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) and mod menu helper from that project, so credit to those mods/resource packs. Shout out to the team behind that mod pack!
